# ADR-112 opt-out rule, net 2: every leaf path on Config's YAML surface, sorted.
# Read by TestConfigSurface_LeafSetRatchet (insecure_settings_sweep_test.go). Adding a path here is
# a classification: "no value of this setting can weaken security". A weakening setting gets an
# InsecureSettingsRegistry entry instead (and is listed here too, since it is on the surface).
